features.description: summary.json and report.md carry token totals, per-verified-feature cost and tokens, median orientation, first-attempt pass rate, rework and verify-fail rate; the retro prompt points at them.
steps: lib/summary.mjs `build` adds the keys the plan named: token totals and per-role sums (in, cache_read, cache_write, out, cache_hit_rate, context_peak), `per_verified_feature` { cost, tokens }, median orientation { tokens, turns }, `first_attempt_pass_rate`, `rework` (ids un-passed by verify or a red suite, or with more than one coding session) and `verify_fail_rate`

tests/run.sh check `summary: tokens, per verified feature, first-attempt rate, rework`: on run demo `jq -e` shows tokens in > 0, per_verified_feature.cost > 0, rework contains A and C, first_attempt_pass_rate == 0.33 (only B passed first time) and verify_fail_rate > 0

report.md shows a `Tokens` row (in, cache hit rate, context peak, per verified feature) and a `Quality` row (first-attempt pass rate, rework, verify-fail rate); tests/run.sh check `report shows tokens and quality` greps both rows in `harness report demo`
prompts/retro.md names summary.json's tokens, orientation, rework and first-attempt keys as inputs
Both checks watched failing first; bash tests/run.sh ends with every check passing

features.description: The ledger row carries harness_version and harness_dirty, and `harness trends --by version` groups the new metrics by harness version.
steps: lib/driver.sh at run start writes `$STATE/harness-version` from `git -C $HARNESS_HOME rev-parse --short HEAD` and `$STATE/harness-dirty` (1 when `git status --porcelain` in $HARNESS_HOME is non-empty), and logs them on the `run <id> on` line; summary.json gains `harness: { version, dirty }`; `ledger-line` writes `harness_version` and `harness_dirty`
tests/run.sh check `ledger row has harness_version and harness_dirty`: the demo row in $T/ledger/runs.jsonl has harness_version == `git -C $HERE/.. rev-parse --short HEAD` and a boolean harness_dirty

`harness trends --by version` prints one row per harness version: runs, passing/total, $ per passing feature, median cache hit rate, median orientation tokens, first-attempt pass rate; plain `harness trends` is unchanged. tests/run.sh check `trends --by version groups the runs`: the output has a row starting with that version and the existing `trends lists every run` check still passes
Both checks watched failing first; bash tests/run.sh ends with every check passing
